verdict.rationale: Pylon documents AI Support Agents that can be assigned issues, take actions, and have outcomes logged (pylon-docs-13, pylon-docs-18, pylon-docs-19, pylon-docs-40), implying some capacity for end-to-end resolution rather than mere routing. However the docs explicitly frame the core function as 'deflect customer questions using content' rather than resolution, and there is no quantified resolution rate, case study, or independent benchmark showing what share of conversations are fully resolved end-to-end. Missing for 10: quantified resolution-rate metrics, third-party/customer-reported resolution outcomes, and clarification that 'deflection' translates into true end-to-end resolution rather than partial handling.
